Inclusion-exclusion expansion of a product of CDFs

Source: R/ie_expand.R
ie_expand.Rd

For a set of exponential rates lam, computes the inclusion-exclusion expansion of \(\prod_{i} (1 - e^{-\lambda_i t})\).

Usage

ie_expand(lam)

Arguments

lam

Numeric vector of positive rates (one per component).

Value

A list with elements:

sign

Integer vector of signs (\(+1\) or \(-1\)).

rate_sum

Numeric vector of summed rates for each term.

Details

Returns sign and rate-sum vectors such that: $$\prod_i (1 - e^{-\lambda_i t}) = \sum_k \text{sign}_k \cdot e^{-\text{rate\_sum}_k \cdot t}$$

The number of terms is \(2^m\) where \(m\) is length(lam).

Examples

ie <- ie_expand(c(1, 2))
# Product: (1 - exp(-t)) * (1 - exp(-2t))
# = 1 - exp(-t) - exp(-2t) + exp(-3t)
ie$sign      # c(1, -1, -1, 1)
#> [1]  1 -1 -1  1
ie$rate_sum  # c(0, 1, 2, 3)
#> [1] 0 1 2 3
